title: The promise, in one sentence
text: What if your app could test itself? Meet Acme, the platform that turns a code repository, or a live URL, into a runnable test suite in minutes.

title: Why anyone should care
text: Teams spend weeks writing and maintaining automated tests. Suites break with every interface change. And most tools produce shallow results that nobody trusts.

title: Getting in
text: Getting started takes seconds. Connect your repository, or simply paste your app's URL. No configuration files. No framework setup. Nothing written by hand.

title: The whole loop, once
text: Here is the loop. Connect your app. Acme explores it. You approve every step. Then it writes the code, runs it in the cloud, and heals what breaks.

title: The thing that wins the demo
text: Now Acme explores your application like a real user. It crawls every page, maps complete journeys, and listens to network traffic to discover your APIs, automatically.

title: What to do next
text: From repository to reliable tests, in under ten minutes. Start free today. Paste your URL, and ship with confidence.
